product_name: Bajaj Life Diabetic Term Plan II Sub 8 HbA1c
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Premium Life Insurance Plan
key_benefits: Term life cover designed for Type-2 diabetics (HbA1c <= 8) and pre-diabetics.
Death Benefit (Sum Assured on Death) = higher of (a) 10x Annualised Premium, (b) 105% of Total Premiums Paid till date of death, or (c) Sum Assured.
No Maturity Benefit — pure term; no benefit on survival to maturity.
Health Management Services (medical second opinion, consultations, webinars) to help manage diabetes/general health.
Premium rebates/discounts: High Sum Assured Rebate (SA > Rs 1 crore), 5% salary rebate, 5% online/web-aggregator/ISNP rebate, 4% staff rebate, preferential rates for non-tobacco users.
Multiple premium-payment frequencies; policy term equals premium payment term.

eligibility.sum_assured_increment: Sum assured chosen in multiples of Rs 1,00,000
eligibility.policy_term: Policy Term equals Premium Payment Term (regular pay)
eligibility.note: Eligibility-criteria table is referenced but the numeric entry/maturity-age, policy-term and min/max sum-assured boundaries are not captured in the parse (only that SA is in multiples of Rs 1,00,000). Verify against the policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document (electronic or otherwise). Refund subject to proportionate risk premium and medical/stamp-duty expenses.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for premium frequencies other than monthly; 15 days for monthly. Cover continues during grace; on death in grace the due-but-unpaid premium is deducted from the benefit.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months from commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever later), the nominee/beneficiary receives 80% of Total Premiums Paid as on date of death, provided the policy is in force. No other death exclusion.
key_terms.surrender_value: No surrender value under this policy; the policy terminates on the date of surrender.
key_terms.revival_note: Revival within 5 years of first unpaid premium; current revival interest 10% p.a. compounded half-yearly (benchmarked to 10-year G-Sec + 2%).
key_terms.tax_note: Premium paid and Death Benefit 'may be eligible for tax benefits as per extant Income Tax Act, subject to the provisions stated therein' — consult a tax consultant; GST charged over and above premium.

claims_marketing_must_support: Eligibility is condition-bound: cover is for Type-2 diabetics with HbA1c <= 8 and pre-diabetics — any 'guaranteed acceptance' or 'all diabetics covered' framing is unsupported; underwriting and health questionnaire apply.
Death Benefit is the higher-of formula (10x annualised premium / 105% of premiums paid / Sum Assured) — must not be reduced to a single simplistic figure.
Health Management Services are optional third-party services at no extra cost and are subject to availability — must be described as such, not as a guaranteed medical benefit.
Premium rebates (HSAR, salary, online, staff) are condition-specific and must be stated with their qualifying conditions.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as an investment, savings or wealth-creation product — it is a non-linked, non-participating pure risk term plan with NO maturity benefit and NO surrender value.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns', 'maturity amount', 'money back' or 'bonus' language — none apply.
Do NOT imply guaranteed/automatic issuance to diabetics — acceptance depends on HbA1c level, health status and underwriting.
Do NOT present Health Management Services as a treatment guarantee or as the company's medical liability.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Premium Life Insurance Plan'
That it is a pure protection term plan with no maturity benefit and no surrender value.
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, conditions and exclusions.

gaps: Numeric entry/maturity age, policy-term range and min/max sum assured not recovered from the parse (only SA-in-multiples-of-Rs-1,00,000 captured).
